production_validation.codegen: Full codegen suite passed (62.381s), including AArch64/default/Apple/LSE and RV64 C-helper translation validation with unchanged proof requirements; both clang and riscv64-elf-gcc are available. Lowering suite passed (0.655s).
production_validation.Lean: Oak.ViewRefinement built successfully (2 jobs); all four existing BLAKE3/SHA256 hash law modules built successfully (6 jobs).

decision: Do not ship the source rewrite from this run. Four of six paired medians improve, two are approximately neutral/slightly worse, and only 71 of 126 pairs improve under heavy shared-host noise. The smaller frame and eliminated copies are promising but insufficient evidence of repeatable elapsed-time improvement. A quiet-host rerun is needed; no speedup or slowdown bound is claimed.
scope: Two cohorts of complete 1 MiB hashes: C update/helpers with the exact same proven native compressor held fixed, and wholly C-compiled hashes. Not whole-package native timing or whole-source-to-binary proof.

change.description: Replace private by-value blake3_push_chunk with blake3_push_cv(stack:[*]u32,depth:u32,counter:u64,cv:[8]u32):u32, mutating only the copied next.stack. Caller snapshots fields/CV before the borrow, then resets the exact same scalar fields. Public blake3_update retains its independent by-value state and unchanged input/boundary loop.
change.compiler_isolation: Both timed variants include the identical recursive aggregate-literal lowering prerequisite. The later oak_index single-evaluation macro fix is NOT in the timed compilers. The hash fixtures use pure index expressions and pass full digest/state/trap checks; do not attribute these samples to the final compiler revision.
change.restored: stdlib/hash.oak is byte-identical to baseline. No BLAKE3 Lean model/extraction change or push theorem ships; checked-index correspondence is updated separately.

static_metrics.measurement: Symbol interval from push to update and update to final, including trap/stack-check tails; update frame from prologue. Logical copy volume is not measured hardware memory traffic. Initial by-value update copy remains.

verification.candidate: C/interpreter hash/reference/full-state/alias/malformed-depth regressions passed (32.762s), with recursive literal lowering and before the later macro fix. Earlier interpreter-only update/push/alias cases passed (3.395s).
verification.new_regressions: Freeze prior push helper exactly apart from name, independently of current source. Twelve successful depth/counter pairs cover empty stack, normal merges, depths53/54, counter wrap, and huge depths whose UInt32*8 wraps to legal checked slots. Chunk-boundary borrowed block-view case checks original state and expected source bytes independently. Four malformed old/new cases pin index432 or4294967288 and extent432 in interpreter, plus C traps.
verification.native: Baseline and candidate compression-only emissions prove all 8 result chunks at default budget with no cache hit; compressor objects match. Both mixed libraries link the same baseline object.
verification.limits: The mutable-stack prototype was not formally refined, and the update/push bodies were not emitted natively for this experiment. Extraction-level push proof was deferred when the runtime acceptance condition was not met.
verification.runtime: All 32 digest bytes agree at 14 lengths (0,1,63,64,65,1023,1024,1025,2048,2049,3072,4096,5000,1048576) and after every timed sample.

compiler_fixes.aggregate_lowering: lowerExpression previously skipped array and record literal values; span/view reads there emitted invalid raw indexing of a C wrapper. Recursively lower their values using existing core_index logic while preserving checked AST and type/field metadata.
compiler_fixes.single_evaluation: Expanded evaluation-order testing exposed oak_index evaluating its index argument twice. Use the existing checked oak_lv_idx helper inside the macro so base, length and index each occur once. This fix is separate from the deferred hash optimization and postdates these frozen timing artifacts.
compiler_fixes.formal_scope: ViewRefinement pins the new C macro, models the checked numeric index result and proves exact in-bounds success/unchanged index and out-of-bounds failure. C operand evaluation is not formally modeled: the text pins and fixed-versus-old-macro execution regression check single evaluation. Existing native C-helper translation-validation proof bars remain unchanged.

host.limitations: Shared-host load, CPU placement/frequency and other work uncontrolled. One-minute boundary readings85.68–146.52. No builds/tests from this experiment or its agents overlap the six timing runs.

protocol.order: Single-thread rotating interleaved variants, distinct RTLD_LOCAL libraries; reverse first two library arguments in runB of each cohort.
protocol.warning: Raw before/after labels are argument positions; B is reversed. Raw c-control is baseline pure-C for mixed, but baseline mixed for pure-C. Ratio of separate medians differs from median of paired ratios; retain both, all samples and all runs.

reproduction: Start at bd89ea49 and apply blake3-stack-push-lowering-prerequisite-2026-09-17.patch to BOTH variants. Apply blake3-stack-push-deferred-2026-09-17.patch only to candidate.
Build each frozen compiler/emitter: go build -o OUT/oak-VARIANT .; go build -o OUT/emit-VARIANT ./benchmarks/native/emit
Pure C: OUT/oak-VARIANT build -o OUT/VARIANT-c.c benchmarks/kernels/oak; cc -dynamiclib -std=c99 -O3 -DNDEBUG -Dmain=oak_unused_main OUT/VARIANT-c.c -o OUT/VARIANT-c.dylib

Native compression: env OAK_NATIVE_ONLY=hash__blake3_ucompress OAK_VERIFY_CACHE=0 OAK_VERIFY_BUDGET= OAK_OPT_SKIP= OAK_NATIVE_UNROLL_SMALL=0 OAK_NATIVE_LOOP_RESULT_HOMES=0 OAK_NATIVE_TIMING=1 OAK_NATIVE_DUMP=1 OUT/emit-VARIANT benchmarks/kernels/oak OUT/VARIANT
Require baseline.o and candidate.o identical and fresh 8-chunk proven verdicts. Link each native C companion to baseline.o with the same dylib flags.

Pause builds/tests. Run harness with absolute paths to baseline/candidate/control dylibs and100 21; reverse first two arguments for B, restore for C, separately for mixed and pure-C cohorts. Record uptime boundaries.
